purpose: M6: dynamic varioref text moves its reference across a page break relative to a fixed float
mechanism: M6 varioref changes reference text according to relative float placement
why_undetected: The narrow varioref syntax model records the page read but omits feedback from rendered reference length to the reference's own placement.
notes: Eight successive TeX runs alternate the page containing the reference between 1 and 2. This oracle states the source mechanism rather than copying the analyser output.
